requirements.text: A class named MetaClass.
A MTRANS model contains metamodels
A MTRANS model has modules. Each module has a name
A MTRANS model has rules. Each rule has two properties: one to state whether the rule is abstract and the other one to store its name
A MTRANS model has inheritances
A MTRANS model has expressions. Each expression has an operator
A MTRANS model has Sections. Each section has a kind
A MTRANS model has instructions
A MTRANS model has variables. Each variable has a name
A MTRANS model contains modules. Each module may have metamodels associated
A MTRANS model has modules. Each module is composed by a set of one or more rules
A MTRANS model has rules. Each rule has a module associated to it
A MTRANS model has modules. Each rule has a source which is a metaclass
A MTRANS model has rules. Each rule is composed by at least one section
A MTRANS model has rules. Each rule might be composed by inheritances
A MTRANS model has inheritances. Each inheritance has a rule associated
A MTRANS model has inheritance objects. Each of which may have inherited rules
An expression can be composed of one and only inherited rule

There are two classes.
The first one is named Expression and the second is named Instruction.
The class Expression has an attribute named instruction of type Instruction and of cardinality 1.
The class Instruction has no attribute.

A rule can have more than one section.
A section can be in one and only rule.

An instruction is composed of one and only expression.
An expression must be associated with one and only instruction.

A variable is associated with one and only rule.
A rule is composed of multiple variables.
